_about: 施法特写 — the casting close-up (Hanli 2026-10-21, after trying a live-drawn ink hand and a 3D model: 「那就水墨, 识别到手势, 放一个预制的动画就好了」): 结印's field; a hand seen → a comic panel slides in with 小满 in side profile, ready; a seal the judge reads → that seal's PRE-PAINTED animation (local FLUX frames), never a hand drawn from the landmarks; a cast → its thrust frame with the element's glow. One component (games/texie/cutin.js) for this test and, later, 结印's dock in 守墙关 · 守炉 · 守山门. 游戏厅 only; not in the story. doc/games.md § 施法特写.
_panel: texie/panel.js: slides in `inMs` after a hand is seen; a cast thrusts for `thrustMs`, the panel fades `afterMs` later over `outMs`, then rests `restMs`; hands gone `goneMs` → it fades.
_cast: A cast: any seal of the device's set (jieyin.json, judge.js sealOf) held `holdMs` — but an open palm (`skip`: 掌 is half of 推掌, § 手势斗法) only shows the hands —, or a push at the camera (zhidian/poke.js on any hand: its size grows `grow` over `windowMs`); then none for `coolMs`. The camera read at `fps` (a push is quick).
_anims: cutin.js: each row one animation, a sprite sheet art/seal-<key>.webp of `frames` (each frame.w × frame.h). `seals`: the jieyin.json seals that play it (a two-hand seal may borrow a one-hand row); `fist`: played by a fist (jieyin.json spells.kou's rule); `castOnly`: shown only on a cast (an open palm is the hand at rest — it must not flash 推掌 all the time). `glow`: the element's colour round the thrust. A hand seen with no row read shows `ready`. Timings (ms): `rise` the first frame before the held one; `thrust` the cast frame; `fade` each cross-fade. A new seal = a new row + its painted sheet (tools/paint-texie-flux.py).

lead.zh: 手举到镜头前：小满的手就是你的手。结一个印，或者往前一推，火蛋出手。
lead.en: Raise your hands to the camera: Xiaoman's hands are yours. Make a seal, or push forward, and the fire egg flies.
